solo.name: leaving while a colleague stays on call succeeds
solo.trace:
solo check: leaving while a colleague stays on call succeeds
call: go_off_call(db, doctor_id=1)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT shift_id FROM doctors WHERE id = 1 -> [(1,)]
step 3   R1  SELECT * FROM doctors WHERE shift_id = 1 AND on_call = true FOR UPDATE -> [(1, 'Alice', 1, True), (2, 'Bob', 1, True)]
step 4   R1  UPDATE doctors SET on_call = false WHERE id = 1 -> UPDATE 1
step 5   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: every shift has at least one doctor on call
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT array_agg(on_call ORDER BY id) = '{f,t}' FROM doctors

scenarios.name: two on call, both ask to leave
three on call, two ask to leave
counterexamples:
scenario: three on call, two ask to leave
R1: go_off_call(db, doctor_id=1)
R2: go_off_call(db, doctor_id=2)
schedule choices: [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0]
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT shift_id FROM doctors WHERE id = 1 -> [(1,)]
step 3   R1  SELECT * FROM doctors WHERE shift_id = 1 AND on_call = true FOR UPDATE -> [(1, 'Alice', 1, True), (2, 'Bob', 1, True), (3, 'Chen', 1, True)]
step 4   R1  UPDATE doctors SET on_call = false WHERE id = 1 -> UPDATE 1
step 5   R2  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE -> BEGIN
step 6   R2  SELECT shift_id FROM doctors WHERE id = 2 -> [(1,)]
step 7   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
step 8   R2  SELECT * FROM doctors WHERE shift_id = 1 AND on_call = true FOR UPDATE -> ERROR 40001 SerializationFailure: could not serialize access due to concurrent update
step 9   R2  ROLLBACK -> ROLLBACK
         R2  raised SerializationFailure (40001): could not serialize access due to concurrent update
invariant ok: every shift has at least one doctor on call
success check ok: Chen is still on call
reproduced on re-run: True
